blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Justice (DOJ) is pressing ahead with its domestic case build-up against Thomas Markle over his alleged violations of Child Sexual Abuse or Exploitation Materials (CSAEM), even though the suspect has already been indicted in the United States. Markle is the estranged father of Meghan Markle, the Duchess of Sussex. Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida said he is not privy to the specific charges filed against Markle in the US.
